title: Tic-Tac-Toe Board Layout
description: Modify styles.css so the webpage displays a centered 3-by-3 tic-tac-toe board using CSS Grid.

instructions.studentPrompt:
Modify styles.css so the webpage displays a centered tic-tac-toe board.

The finished page should show a 3-by-3 board beneath the Tic-Tac-Toe heading. The board contains nine square cells arranged in three columns and three rows. Each cell is 100px wide and 100px tall. There is a 10px gap between neighboring cells. The board is centered horizontally on the page. The existing light-blue cell borders, red X marks, and blue O marks should remain unchanged.

Add the following declarations to the #board selector in styles.css:

- display: grid
- grid-template-columns with three columns that are each 100px wide
- grid-template-rows with three rows that are each 100px tall
- grid-gap: 10px
- justify-content: center

Return the complete styles.css file.
